text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaa!? Eh? Eh!? What is happening…?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Woah! Everyone is laughing!!
They look like they're 
having so much fun!!
What is it? Did something funny 
happen!? I wanna hear about it too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't believe that anything in
particular happened… You see,
El and Opera O-san both had 
solos during the live concert,
didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Due to that fact,
a debate began regarding who the real star
of 
the show was. Was it the world's strongest,
the century's 
greatest emperor, the top tier,
or the class representative?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
…Status: Incomprehensible.
No connection can be found between 
simultaneous laughter and the process of
settling an argument.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I agree.
They have been at it for 15 minutes now,
you'd think 
they would have noticed that by now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
…Plus, for us, when we say settle, 
there really is only one…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph… It seems that we 
will have to truly settle this matter.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You all really are a delight.
